messages:
auditor: Hi team — we need a presigned S3 export for incident RWI-2267 (2026-03-10). Request: auth + gateway + request traces for 2026-03-10 14:00-15:00 UTC, chain-of-custody steps, and presigned URL TTL. Prefer TTL >= 7d. Also need confirmation on PII redaction and sampling size.
rachel: @auditor acknowledged. Two quick clarifying q's: do you want full request bodies or headers + request_id + user identifiers (hashed)? Also confirm exact retention window.
auditor: Headers + request_id + hashed user_id + timestamps. No raw PII. Retention window: 14:00–15:00 UTC, but include adjacent 15m before/after for context.
matt: tagging this to support ticket #SUP-5123 — customer reported repeated 503s and auth failures in that timeframe. Will need meter logs for billing spikes too.
sre-eli: We have edge/gateway logs and GPU autoscaler events. To repro the 503 flow we need API gateway logs + upstream pool scaling traces + auth token rotation events.
eng-ops-lina: Note: our presigned export pipeline defaults to 24h TTL. Extending to 7d is doable but requires staging bucket policy tweak. Also chain-of-custody doc needs an operator signature and SHA256 checksums for each archive.
auditor: 7d TTL required. Chain-of-custody: steps + operator name + sha256 checksum per file. Also a short human-readable statement of custody.
rachel: Plan: produce the following artifacts
- logs_slice_20260310-1400_1500.tar.gz (headers+ids, redacted bodies)
- kms_audit_20260310-1300_1600.csv (key id, api calls, operator id)
- autoscaler_events_20260310.json
- meter_counts_20260310.csv (token counts, per-route)
We will include a signed manifest with SHA256 checksums and operator signature.
matt: For the billing ask: include per-route token counts and the metering trace. I'll attach SUP-5123 notes to the export.
eng-ops-lina: KMS/HSM note: we cannot export HSM internals. We'll include KMS API call logs and a signed HSM manifest indicating which keys were present and rotation events. No plaintext keys will be exported.
auditor: Confirm no unencrypted keys or secrets included. Also need proof of lifecycle rules for archived logs (deletion policy) and a snapshot showing lifecycle applied on 2026-03-01.
rachel: Confirmed: no plaintext secrets. Exports will include metadata only. Retention: access logs hot=90d, archive=365d. We'll include a lifecycle policy snapshot and an S3 object listing showing lifecycle tags applied.
sre-eli: Quick repro steps for the 503s we plan to include (small script):
```bash
# quick repro: flood /v1/generate with parallel clients
for i in $(seq 1 500); do
  curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total} %{url_effective}\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" \
    -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":16}' &
done
wait
```
Notes: 500 parallel clients ~ token pressure on dedicated pool; include token bucket limits.
matt: please include request_id values for the sample 503 responses so we can cross-ref customer reports. I'll grep edge logs once slice is ready.
auditor: Also need to confirm hashing approach for user_id: algorithm and whether salt is reversible or stored. We need assurance that user IDs are non-reversible.
rachel: We hash user_id with SHA256 + per-environment salt stored in Vault. We'll include algorithm docs and salt management notes (not the salt itself). Statement: hashing is non-reversible; salt access is restricted to ops.
deploy-bot: export-job rwe-export-3165009999 queued -> preparing archive.
eng-ops-lina: ETA for upload to staging bucket (presigned links with 7d TTL): 2026-03-18 18:00 UTC. Will post links in this thread when complete.
auditor: Please confirm redaction sample size (we need 5 sample request bodies redacted to verify process).
rachel: We'll include five sample redacted bodies and the redaction script snippet. Redaction = remove 'email', 'ssn', and 'credit_card' fields; replace with <REDACTED>.
deploy-bot: export-job rwe-export-3165009999 started -> packing archives.
matt: attaching support ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/5123 — will add customer repro notes and sample request_ids.
auditor: Thanks. Notify when presigned links are posted. Also provide operator sign-off on chain-of-custody before download.
rachel: Understood. We'll attach operator signature and manifest. Will post links + sha256 checksums after upload.
deploy-bot: upload complete. Presigned URLs (7d) posted to staging (links redacted in public thread).
